V1_noise_scale.claim: eps_num bound of Thm 3.2 is never violated

V2_fixed_tolerance.claim: in binary64 the failure is one-sided: a fixed eps misses defects below it and asserts INCONSISTENT where the data cannot resolve the question; the false-positive mode appears only at lower precision

V3_trichotomy.claim: UNDECIDABLE is non-empty and occupies a real region

V4_basis_dependence.claim: verdict agrees across bases; flagged set need not; witness set contains the defect under both
